column1: # Two-slot OTA partition table for the 16 MB ESP32-C5.
# nvs and otadata keep the standard offsets/sizes (0x9000/0x5000 and
# 0xe000/0x2000) so saved settings survive a table change. App slots are 6 MB
# each against a ~1.5 MB image -- the C5 build links large (Arduino core 3 /
# IDF 5.5) and the 16 MB part has the room.
#   0x00E000    8 KB  otadata     which slot the bootloader should run
